Устройство одной плитки карты рынка: Anatomy of a single market map tile
Цвет плитки — это изменение цены. Красны: Tile colour is the price change. Red = decline, green = gain, dark grey centre = "almost flat".
The more saturated the colour, the bigger the move.
Шкала цвета от красного через серый к зе: Colour scale from red through grey to green
Плитки собраны в блоки по отраслям. Внут: Tiles are grouped into industry blocks. Each block holds the companies of that sector, so you can tell in a second which industry is green and which is red.
Размер плитки пропорционален выбранной в: Tile size is proportional to the chosen measure: "Market cap" is the company's value, "Turnover" is how much was traded. Heavyweights take up more room.
Крупные компании занимают больше места: Large companies take up more room
Все акции Московской биржи в виде прямоу: Every Moscow Exchange stock as a rectangular tile on a single screen. Each tile is one company. Tiles are grouped by industry. In two or three seconds you see the overall state of the market: strength or weakness today, which sectors lead and who is moving the indices.

размер плитки — вклад компании в рынок,: tile size is the company's weight in the market, tile colour is its price change over the selected period.
Data comes from the Moscow Exchange.
Над картой стоит ряд переключателей. Раз: A row of toggles sits above the map. Let's go through each one — what it does and what each option means.
Только акции из основного индекса Москов: Only the constituents of the main Moscow Exchange index — the largest companies. There are about fifty of them, yet they cover most of the market by capitalisation. The map is compact and fully legible.
Вся вселенная Московской биржи — сотни к: The whole Moscow Exchange universe — hundreds of companies, including second- and third-tier names. You see everything, but the smallest tiles may become unreadable. Available on paid plans.
Плитки собраны в блоки по отраслям: нефт: Tiles are collected into industry blocks: oil & gas, banks, metals, consumer and so on. Each block is labelled with its industry. Sector moves are easier to spot.
Отрасли отключены, все плитки лежат вмес: Industries are switched off; all tiles sit together sorted by size only. The largest companies gather in one corner — handy when size matters more than sector.
Площадь плитки пропорциональна рыночной: Tile area is proportional to the company's market value. The largest issuers take up more room. A stable measure — it changes slowly.
Размер зависит от того, сколько бумаги н: Size depends on how much of the stock was traded over the selected period. Highlights where activity is concentrated right now. A volatile measure — it can jump on news.
Определяет, за какой срок считается изме: Sets the horizon over which the price change shown by tile colour is measured. Only the colouring changes — size and grouping stay the same.
Изменение за сегодняшний торговый день,: Change over today's trading session, from the previous close.
Кнопка-камера сохраняет текущий вид карт: The camera button saves the current map view as an image — with all tiles, mode and period captions and the site watermark. Handy for reports.
Внутри каждой достаточно крупной плитки: Every tile large enough shows the company ticker and its percentage change over the selected period. The tile colour echoes the same percentage:
цена выросла. Чем насыщеннее зелёный, те: the price rose. The deeper the green, the bigger the gain.
цена упала. Чем насыщеннее красный, тем: the price fell. The deeper the red, the bigger the decline.
Насыщенность цвета подстраивается под вы: Colour saturation adapts to the selected period so the map stays contrasty on a daily as well as a yearly horizon.
Если навести курсор на плитку, появится: Hovering over a tile opens a detail card: ticker and full company name, the current price in roubles and the changes over all four periods at once — day, week, month and year. This lets you compare how the stock behaved on different horizons without switching the period for the whole map.
размер плитки — вклад компании в рынок,: tile size is the company's weight in the market, colour is its change. This gives an instant picture of "where the money is and what is happening to it".
Тяжеловесы (Сбер, Лукойл, Газпром) снижа: The heavyweights (Sber, Lukoil, Gazprom) are falling. Their market weight is large, so on such days the index is usually down too, even if mid-sized stocks are up.
Море красного, но яркие зелёные пятна: A sea of red with bright green patches
Общий день слабый, но отдельные сектора: A weak day overall, but individual sectors or stocks are moving against the tide. Often driven by earnings, stock-specific news or dividends.
Отраслевой рост — нередко связан с новос: A sector-wide rally — often tied to news (oil prices, regulatory changes, deals). Within the sector the move is usually led by the largest names.
Тяжеловесы почти стоят, а движение сосре: The heavyweights are nearly flat while the action is in small caps. The index barely moves, though there can be plenty of activity in small capitalisation.
Переключи период и сравни. Красный за де: Switch the period and compare. Red on the day with green on the month may point to a local pullback within a longer rally; red on both suggests a more prolonged decline.
